w = int(input())
m = int(input())

sum_arr = [0] * 105
pw = [0] * 105
possible = [False]

p = 1
maxIndex = 0
for i in range(100):
    sum_arr[i + 1] = sum_arr[i] + p
    pw[i] = p
    p *= w
    if p > (1 << 40):
        maxIndex = i
        break

def verify(current, target, index, sum_arr, pw, possible):
    if possible[0]:
        return
    if current == target:
        possible[0] = True
        return
    remainingSum = sum_arr[index + 1]
    powerVal = pw[index]

    if current - remainingSum > target or current + remainingSum < target:
        return

    if current + sum_arr[index] < target:
        verify(current + powerVal, target, index - 1, sum_arr, pw, possible)
    elif current - sum_arr[index] > target:
        verify(current - powerVal, target, index - 1, sum_arr, pw, possible)
    else:
        verify(current, target, index - 1, sum_arr, pw, possible)

verify(0, m, maxIndex, sum_arr, pw, possible)
print("YES" if possible[0] else "NO")
